summary.zh: 0.4.0：登录页视觉打磨，设置页账号栏内置多账号切换，多项登录体验修复。
summary.en: 0.4.0: login page visual polish, multi-account switching built into Settings, and several sign-in experience fixes.

items.zh: 登录页视觉优化：分隔符居中为「— or —」样式，整体排版更规整
items.en: Login page polish: centered “— or —” divider and tidier layout

items.zh: 设置页账号栏直接内置多账号切换列表（无条件显示）：点行切换、侧按钮移除
items.en: Settings account section embeds the multi-account switcher directly (always visible): tap to switch, side button to remove

items.zh: 修复自部署 OAuth 弹窗被输入法遮挡的问题
items.en: Fixed the self-hosted OAuth sheet being covered by the keyboard
